decisions: 17 IA routes: /, /services, 7 service pages (SEO_STRATEGY slugs), /work, /work/[slug], /about, /contact, /privacy (conditional on PostHog key), /blog + /blog/[slug] (optional, owner decides Q9), /404. Parity with WIREFRAMES.md checked by grep (17 = 17).

Services grouped Print (01-03) / Digital (04-05) / Design & build (06-07) in SEO priority order; all 12 old-site titles mapped to a parent page (new:also-covered-index on /services). Owner may reorder at G1; slugs stay fixed.

Primary conversion = WhatsApp with a page-aware prefill built at build time from route data (service pages: 'quote for <service>. Item/quantity… Needed by…'; work items: 'something like <title>'). Secondary: tel, mailto (page-aware subject), Maps directions. All via components/contact/ContactChannels.tsx; no forms (D14).

Persistent mobile CTA = new:wa-dock (<768px): WhatsApp 2/3 + Call 1/3, >=48px targets, safe-area inset, CSS-reserved body padding so nothing is covered, in SSR HTML from first paint, show/hide by transform/opacity only (no CLS), hides when footer CTA / page contact block is in view or the menu is open. No FAB at >=768px: the sticky header carries the WhatsApp pill + tel.
Header top bar = Services (disclosure panel of the 7), Work, Contact + WhatsApp pill; About moves to the mobile overlay and footer to respect nav-minimal-overlay's 3-link limit.

Proof slots degrade by omission: logos render only if >=4 approved, reviews only if approved, work items only with >=1 approved image; empty /work shows new:empty-state-samples (WhatsApp 'send me samples' + directions). No placeholders, no founding year until the owner confirms one.

faq-answer-first on / and all 7 service pages with SEO_STRATEGY questions; price/turnaround are 'ask' answers ending in a WhatsApp link; answers present in HTML without JS. No FAQ on /services or /contact to avoid duplicate FAQPage content.

No medium perf_cost patterns anywhere (hero-interactive-object rejected: bad_for low-end mobile). Hero/H1/first CTA never use reveal motion; motion-scroll-reveal-restrained only on sections below the first viewport.

Deviations from PAGES.md defaults: /work uses new:work-caption-grid (image-first) instead of work-grid-hover-reveal (product hidden until hover, poor on touch, not good_for company-site); /contact uses new:contact-channels instead of contact-inline-form (D14).
risks: Content-thin launch: service specs, scope lists, samples, reviews and logos all depend on owner confirmation; with nothing confirmed, service pages fall back to hero + checklist + process + FAQ + related, which is still complete but lighter.
hero-oversized-type-split's line stagger must be dropped on first-viewport headings (LCP lesson); design-director/frontend must not reintroduce it.

wa-dock hide-on-intersect needs a small client script; without JS the dock simply stays visible (acceptable). Reserved bottom padding must match the dock height exactly, or the last footer line is covered.
/work?service= filter is client-side only; canonical must stay /work so filtered URLs are not indexed as duplicates.
Work items sourced from PDFs may only exist as collection sets, not per-project stories; case-study-sticky-meta then runs in caption-only mode.
410 handling for demo URLs needs Worker code (SEO_STRATEGY); /404 is the designed fallback.
open_questions: Service order and which service leads (PRODUCT Q1); IA order is SEO-priority until confirmed.
Hours and walk-ins (Q2): gate the hours row and the walk-in note in visit-studio and on /contact.
Founding year (Q3): gates the about intro and any years claim.
Logo/review permissions and Justdial rating quote (Q4): gate the hero proof chip, logo strip and reviews.
Confirmed papers/finishes, offset item list, NFC update capability, logo deliverables, social/ads scope, bulk WhatsApp/SMS DLT compliance, mobile apps: gate spec-list rows and conditional sections.
Blog revived or not (Q9); delivery outside Jaipur (Q10) gates the delivery step and home FAQ Q6.
Optional enhancement for G1: turn quote-checklist into tap-to-select chips that compose the WhatsApp prefill client-side (no data stored; still no form submission). Not planned by default.
next_instructions: G1: present USER_FLOW.md, IA.md and WIREFRAMES.md with the open questions above to the owner.

design-director (S3): visual language for the patterns in WIREFRAMES §B; keep H1-as-LCP and no first-viewport reveal; the wa-dock and header WhatsApp pill are the primary CTA treatments; the typographic fallbacks for missing hero assets must look intentional, not empty.
growth (S4): content/faq/*.json per WIREFRAMES FAQ blocks; routes.json for 17 routes (privacy/blog conditional, /404 noindex); WhatsApp prefill strings and mailto subjects as editable content data.
frontend (S4): build proof sections as data-driven with approved flags and omission fallbacks; ContactChannels.tsx supplies all channel links incl. page-aware prefill.
